Driver Performance
Driver Complete Summary
Sorted by Performance Score — lowest returns weighted highest, then delivery volume and value equally (Deliveries ÷ (Deliveries + Returns) × 60 + Deliveries ÷ Highest Deliveries × 20 + Value ÷ Highest Value × 20), highest first. Use Home → Driver to isolate one driver across the entire software.
